about: Golden diffs for scripts/review-triage.mjs (run by scripts/run-evals.mjs). exit 0 = generated files only, no AI review; exit 1 = the full review must run.

cases.name: triage: the track index is generated
triage: a new ?v= hash on a page line is generated
cases.diff:
diff --git a/index.html b/index.html
--- a/index.html
+++ b/index.html
@@ -1 +1 @@
-<script src="assets/site.js?v=aaaaaa1"></script>
+<script src="assets/site.js?v=bbbbbb2"></script>

cases.name: triage: a changed page line with a hash is not generated
cases.diff:
diff --git a/index.html b/index.html
--- a/index.html
+++ b/index.html
@@ -1 +1 @@
-<script src="assets/site.js?v=aaaaaa1"></script>
+<script src="assets/evil.js?v=bbbbbb2"></script>

cases.name: triage: a binary change needs a review
cases.diff:
diff --git a/assets/og.png b/assets/og.png
Binary files a/assets/og.png and b/assets/og.png differ

cases.name: triage: a mode change needs a review
cases.diff:
diff --git a/scripts/x.sh b/scripts/x.sh
old mode 100644
new mode 100755

cases.name: triage: a rename needs a review
cases.diff:
diff --git a/scripts/a.mjs b/scripts/b.mjs
similarity index 100%
rename from scripts/a.mjs
rename to scripts/b.mjs
